files.README.md:
Admissions roll-up - programming office
=======================================

admissions_rollup.py is the circuit's weekly seating report. The
programming office runs it from the project root with

    python3 admissions_rollup.py

and it has to search the whole project tree for the houses' admits.csv
drop files. The tills save them wherever they land: some sit straight
in a house folder, others are tucked under an exports folder after a
late sync, so a search that stops at one level will miss drops.

Every admits.csv has this shape:

    house,slot,seats_sold

    house        venue code the seats belong to
    slot         performance slot
    seats_sold   tickets sold for that slot

The report, written to standard output:

    house,seats
    <house>,<seats>      one line per house, ascending by house code
    total,<seats>

<seats> for a house is the sum of seats_sold across every row of every
admits.csv that names that house.
